title: Prior Authorization Decision Notice and Reviewer Standards
content:
**Correspondence and review standards.** For each Prior Authorization class, Prairie Ridge Health Plan sets the business days after the decision within which the written decision notice is mailed, the physician specialty that must make any denial, and the business days after a denial during which the requesting provider may ask for a peer-to-peer discussion.

| Class | Written notice mailed within (business days after the decision) | Physician specialty that makes any denial | Peer-to-peer window (business days after the denial) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Advanced Imaging Authorization | 3 | radiology | 5 |
| Outpatient Rehabilitation Therapy Authorization | 3 | physical medicine and rehabilitation | 5 |
| Durable Medical Equipment Authorization | 3 | physical medicine and rehabilitation | 5 |
| Home Health Services Authorization | 3 | internal medicine | 5 |
| Behavioral Health Intensive Services Authorization | 3 | psychiatry | 5 |
| Elective Inpatient and Surgical Authorization | 3 | surgery | 5 |
| Out-of-Network Services Authorization | 3 | internal medicine | 5 |

**Across the classes.** The mailing standard is 3 business days and the peer-to-peer window is 5 business days in every class; only the reviewing specialty differs by class.

**Hypothetical reading.** A hypothetical denial in the Behavioral Health Intensive Services Authorization class is made by a psychiatrist; its written notice is mailed within 3 business days of the decision, and the requesting provider may ask for a peer-to-peer discussion within 5 business days of the denial.
